bundle.shortDescription: A user-visible FairyOS presence shell and native-sensed desktop swarm for Windows.
bundle.longDescription: Faeryware gives RavenOS and FairyOS a resident Windows portal plus one transparent click-through army surface per monitor at startup, six deterministic Digi Fae bodies, eighteen echoes, cursor-aware swarm physics, output-peak-reactive MusicOS motion, opt-in read-only UI Automation perching, summon reactions, tray presence, local-only event ingress, notifications, continuity, and an embedded model carrier.
